Body.Content:
What and why:

Microsoft is improving the appearance of highlighted text while users compose messages in dark mode and high contrast mode. This update provides a more consistent and accessible editing experience by improving the visual presentation of highlighted content across supported themes.

Rollout schedule:

  • Targeted Release (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in mid-September 2026 and is expected to be complete by late September 2026.
  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Rollout will begin in late September 2026 and is expected to be complete by early October 2026.

Impact on your organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users who compose messages using dark mode or high contrast mode.

Platforms and services:

  • Microsoft 365 message-composition experiences that support text highlighting.

After this update:

  • Highlighted text will display more consistently in dark mode and high contrast mode.
  • Users may notice improved readability and a more uniform editing experience when working with highlighted content.
  • This is a visual enhancement only. It does not change existing text-highlighting functionality or user workflows.

Action required / Recommendations:

No action is required. You may want to inform users about this visual improvement if your organization communicates Microsoft 365 experience updates to end users.

Compliance Considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
